summary: Vaxart filed an 8-K regarding Modification No. 7 to its BARDA-funded Project Agreement for a Phase 2b COVID-19 vaccine trial. The modification reduces total funding to approximately $345 million (down ~$116 million) after a 50% participant reduction due to a BARDA partial termination. It includes ~$68 million firm fixed price and reimbursement for trial costs, with $29 million released for completion and exploratory analyses. This is a government contract modification, not a corporate special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or structural change is involved.
